versions.changelog:
Initial release of the popups skill.

- Provides expert guidance on creating and optimizing popups, modals, overlays, slide-ins, and banners for conversion.
- Covers trigger strategies, design best practices, compliance/accessibility, and measurement.
- Includes templates and recommendations for types like email capture, lead magnets, discounts, announcements, slide-ins, and exit intent popups.
- Offers detailed advice on frequency capping, targeting, and minimizing user annoyance.
- Designed for any overlay or interrupt-style conversion element.
